_seo.description: The first post on a blog written in Sluurp's admin.

body.text: This blog is a Sluurp app with no code of its own for storing posts: they are a content collection, written in the admin, drafted, reviewed and published there.
Pages drawn on the server, for search engines and link previews
Posts in two languages, linked as translations
A feed and a sitemap made for it

_seo.description: Le premier billet d'un blog écrit dans l'admin de Sluurp.

body.text: Ce blog est une app Sluurp sans code à elle pour garder ses billets : ils sont une collection de contenu, écrite dans l'admin.

articles.title: Drafts, reviews and a time to publish

_seo.description: How a post goes from a first draft to the site.

body.text: A writer saves drafts and sends them for review. An editor changes them. A publisher puts them live, now or at a time.
Nothing a reader sees changes until it is published.
